QF.id: AIFM CIII Fee Structure and Fund Performance_13

question.text: Fund posted 16% return; benchmark Nifty 50 posted 11%; annualised tracking error = 4%. Compute the Information Ratio (IR).

explanation.text: **The Logic:** IR = (Rp − Rb) / TE = (16% − 11%) / 4% = 5/4 = 1.25. IR > 0.5 is good; > 1.0 is excellent. It measures active-return-per-unit-of-active-risk. **The Trap:** 0.80 inverts. 4.00 forgets the TE denominator. 1.45 arithmetic slip. **Cross-Exam Context:** XV Research Analyst covers IR; XIX-E frames IR as a key Cat III pitch metric — high IR justifies 20% carry. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Report IR on 36-month rolling basis. A single-year IR can spike on a lucky tail; LPs allocate on multi-year IR consistency.
